packet.title: The sxml command's gaps: written files, csv, option hints (implementation)

body.p: After , , . The command wrote nothing but EXPath File output.

item.p: Specifications: XSLT 4.0 (2.4.6 base output URI, 26.2 result documents), the XQuery Update Facility 3.0 (6.1 fn:put), Serialization 4.0 (CSV output method); the rules of docs/CLI.md (: one intent, one action; files only where the command line names them; --force to replace).

Mechanism: one file writer interface for the commands (sxml_cli_file_writer, beside the file reader), temporary file and move on commit; the query run commits or abandons all its files at the end. No library header changes.
Owns: apps/ (new apps/sxml/platform_file_writer.c), tests/cli/, apps/sxml/README.md, docs/CLI.md.

Done when: --output and --force on xpath, xquery, transform and serialize; result documents with an href under an explicit option; fn:put under an explicit flag; --method=csv; hints for a command's misspelled options; CLI tests with goldens, help and README with real output. Done 2026-10-19 (): --output=FILE/-o, --force, sxml transform --result-directory=DIR, sxml xquery --allow-put, --method=csv, other commands' options named; CLI tests 161 to 203.
